faq.q1: Do you work with businesses remotely, or do you need to be on-site?
faq.a1: Most of our work — design, development, and SEO — is done remotely, with on-site or video consultations available for planning and reviews. Distance doesn't slow down the project.
faq.q2: Can you build a site that works well in both Arabic/Persian and English?
faq.a2: Yes — proper right-to-left (RTL) layout, not just translated text forced into a left-to-right design, is standard on every multilingual project we build.
faq.q3: How is pricing different for a project in this region versus elsewhere?
faq.a3: Pricing is based on scope (pages, features, platform), not location. Use our free cost calculator or book a consultation for an exact quote regardless of where you're based.
